_comment: Forja MCP server template. Copy to .mcp.json (gitignored) and replace placeholders. Entries marked REQUIRED are dependencies of core skills; entries marked OPTIONAL can be removed if the corresponding skill is not in use. Audit trimestral (AP4): cualquier entry sin uso real se elimina.

context7._reason: Wrapper over Context7 (https://github.com/upstash/context7) — up-to-date docs for external libs. Default tool of `find-docs` skill. Resuelve alucinación de sintaxis post-cutoff. R13 enforces [docs:libname] citation grammar for any external-lib claim.
context7._alt_form_stdio: Optional fallback: replace url+headers with `"command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@upstash/context7-mcp@latest"], "env": {"CONTEXT7_API_KEY": "${CONTEXT7_API_KEY}"}` if remote MCP is blocked.
